Keep every row in order. Preserve all [[I]], [[B]], [[SC]] emphasis markers, [[Nnumber]] note markers and explicit source line counts. Do not return hashes; the host binds immutable hashes.", "context": {"title": "Les Misérables", "unit": 178, "heading": "II ORAISON FUNÈBRE DE BLONDEAU, PAR BOSSUET", "previous_rows": [{"source_id": "fr81-u178-r0030", "target": "― Прежде всего, — перебил Лэгль, — я прошу позволения набальзамировать Блондо несколькими фразами прочувствованной хвалы. Предположим, что он умер. В его худобе, бледности, холодности, закоснелости и запахе пришлось бы изменить немногое. И я говорю: [[I]]Erudimini qui judicatis terram.[[/I]] Здесь покоится Блондо, Блондо Нос, Блондо Назика, бык дисциплины, [[I]]bos disciplinæ[[/I]], цепной пёс устава, ангел переклички, который был прям, четок, точен, суров, честен и безобразен. Бог вычеркнул его, как он вычеркнул меня.", "source_sha256": "b461183e203e06a624f44b66d3cd9a8480df4dd70e8c433d3debad817b86e8ae", "target_id": "ru-fr81-u178-r0030", "tag": "prose", "target_sha256": "147858f21436d9086fe6f6eb2696e85a7b8168cf2cbebc47efcd053df2495dad"}, {"source_id": "fr81-u178-r0031", "target": "Мариус заговорил снова:", "source_sha256": "6d3c95e83d3ed577078a7c565e8ce71ad61add5e03604b89184c6d599ddf14e0", "target_id": "ru-fr81-u178-r0031", "tag": "prose", "target_sha256": "06dbc8f17f414aab45192cc176e9099f8623968c7a9c65a44f2af80fab1a7ca7"}], "source_language": "French", "part": 3, "book": 4, "chapter": 2, "role": "CHAPTER"}, "source_rows": [{"id": "fr81-u178-r0032", "tag": "prose", "text": "― Je suis désolé…", "sha256": "6c0606dda9f8ea2c697e4a40fbe048ac3d33be83ea091e8bbc2ec788f356e556", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u178-r0033", "tag": "prose", "text": "― Jeune homme, dit Laigle de Meaux, que ceci vous serve de leçon. À l’avenir, soyez exact.", "sha256": "0cac279ddd1c2f211203be870479af4a6d0bdb06deca1b3609c1fa40e5092b0d", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u178-r0034", "tag": "prose", "text": "― Je vous fais vraiment mille excuses.", "sha256": "0f9f0d7ada5ab62f609ed885838143d486725fc5500697c0e02c224538c6c0cb", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u178-r0035", "tag": "prose", "text": "― Ne vous exposez plus à faire rayer votre prochain.", "sha256": "5c20b15ce7b3149c739b8dd225097d53c22e6f2a19671d0ae3c7e8c6a7814c81", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u178-r0036", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Je suis désespéré…", "sha256": "2042c4fdc28ca025a83d99c080ac1a0ab2f0cd32ff541365737bf5e113a66f57", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u178-r0037", "tag": "prose", "text": "Laigle éclata de rire.", "sha256": "9842c31495e724532db7f3df368b423ed59657320dd62c09c56185875693a47e", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u178-r0038", "tag": "prose", "text": "― Et moi, ravi. J’étais sur la pente d’être avocat. Cette rature me sauve. Je renonce aux triomphes du barreau. Je ne défendrai point la veuve et je n’attaquerai point l’orphelin. Plus de toge, plus de stage. Voilà ma radiation obtenue. C’est à vous que je la dois, monsieur Pontmercy. J’entends vous faire solennellement une visite de remercîments. Où demeurez-vous ?", "sha256": "788ae65cf952c6368d0f5b7cf6a7a85a15e2aef5d60c36413f46def2b5017659", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u178-r0039", "tag": "prose", "text": "― Dans ce cabriolet, dit Marius.", "sha256": "de0bc170412745831ae53e4c91d8b0841460c7ecfac0e3e4125195362e42363e", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u178-r0040", "tag": "prose", "text": "― Signe d’opulence, repartit Laigle avec calme. Je vous félicite. Vous avez là un loyer de neuf mille francs par an.", "sha256": "c85909c4da785e47f2dbe891cc2580263efcec1dc307838f724797355aff2fab", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u178-r0041", "tag": "prose", "text": "En ce moment Courfeyrac sortait du café.", "sha256": "88759607385ca562e8eb3eb028dfe4ed85f10252601bc628b87bc6d5144846bf", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u178-r0042", "tag": "prose", "text": "Marius sourit tristement.", "sha256": "818a37c0c38e22170da3793d9b4fa05b2645540d6bf1b264b82324bee2f199ff", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u178-r0043", "tag": "prose", "text": "― Je suis dans ce loyer depuis deux heures et j’aspire à en sortir ; mais, c’est une histoire comme cela, je ne sais où aller.", "sha256": "f776318891a26efaa1405b6fd7e93195f084e1a0fd28caabcbb17be6127416c4", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u178-r0044", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Monsieur, dit Courfeyrac, venez chez moi.", "sha256": "bdae800c96279323ac419ea32af8f968ee55f146b3d6d98fc55fd1f79880b6ae", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u178-r0045", "tag": "prose", "text": "― J’aurais la priorité, observa Laigle, mais je n’ai pas de chez moi.", "sha256": "7d7214fa9ffaf32a1c29a39758aa03fe8a669e19904fc65c41ea9eed075225a6", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u178-r0046", "tag": "prose", "text": "― Tais-toi, Bossuet, reprit Courfeyrac.", "sha256": "7389a93c1eaf990e6aaa02a6c0406a7e6592d52eb11f6ac5475db2ade51a996d", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u178-r0047", "tag": "prose", "text": "― Bossuet, fit Marius, mais il me semblait que vous vous appeliez Laigle.", "sha256": "b7cfb871eae77d02bcfaffc176fecd000be6c5c58ac27505be114a5ee73700fe", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u178-r0048", "tag": "prose", "text": "― De Meaux, répondit Laigle ; par métaphore, Bossuet.", "sha256": "747da60437393ba9de15025a4786f227057d8df9f1ab8d070a9864d2174726f0", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u178-r0049", "tag": "prose", "text": "Courfeyrac monta dans le cabriolet.", "sha256": "8f6a6374e26d08e0201fcb91a1e09b334cc95c38b34590bebdc0098e18bceb8d", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u178-r0050", "tag": "prose", "text": "― Cocher, dit-il, hôtel de la Porte-Saint-Jacques.", "sha256": "6e4096b9966ad75b87ebf0d50d3516f1d5272a929bc7661d633857601c66b090", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u178-r0051", "tag": "prose", "text": "Et le soir même, Marius était installé dans une chambre de l’hôtel de la Porte-Saint-Jacques côte à côte avec Courfeyrac.", "sha256": "e27c295727b5ff528421adcc2ca08f64e7579ea874861f8c8a7c64a509166139", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}]}
